hook: Nottingham Forest defeated Manchester City 3-1 with only 22 percent possession.

sections.voiceover: Nottingham Forest defeated Manchester City 3-1 with only 22 percent possession.
b_roll: Scoreboard showing Nottingham Forest 3, Manchester City 1 at City Ground
Stat graphic displaying 22 percent possession figure

sections.voiceover: At the City Ground, manager Glasner led Nottingham Forest to end their five-game winless run. How many passes did Manchester City complete in that fixture?
b_roll: Exterior shot of the City Ground stadium
Pass counter graphic showing 138 completed passes

sections.voiceover: Manchester City completed 665 passes, yet Liam Delap scored a magnificent brace.
b_roll: Comparison bar chart showing 665 passes versus 138 passes
Graphic highlighting Liam Delap scoring 2 goals

sections.voiceover: Liam Delap scored twice to secure the 3-1 Premier League victory. City completed 665 passes but scored only 1 goal.
b_roll: Match statistics summary showing final score 3-1
Possession pie chart showing 22 percent to 78 percent

sections.voiceover: Forest won 3-1 while completing only 138 total passes.
b_roll: Final match summary graphic with 3-1 result and 138 pass stat
